 indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

 Mohamed El Nahal, tested by eng. Khaled Ahmad El-Sayed, accepted by

 Nasser Bahgat MPIS coordinator, approved by eng. Mahmoud El 
 Naquib head sector of Ayon Mousa PS. 
 and certified by eng. Solman Zaki Soliman general manager of inspection 
 and quality insurance.

sections.text:
Filters , cooler & Tank out of 
service
Closing delivery and suction valves of filters & coolers.

تأكد من أن المرشحات والمبردات يجب أن تكون ذات تهوية كاملة 
 تصريف الزيت لتنظيف الخزان.

Clean oil by Alfa Laval and adjust oil level of tank to site 
 values which is (highest from top of tank = 500 mm & lowest from top of tank = 
 550 mm).
Check bolts fixation, then retightens it (if it is needed).
Check the validity of oil and add or change it (if it is needed).

Clean the tank if it is needed & flashing the tank with the oil requirement 
 10 m3.
Check flanges for leakage.
Check Filtration particle size clean or replace (if it is needed).
